name: Japanese · Phrases · Transport and directions
source: Phrases: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org) sentences written by native speakers, each linked in its src; lines marked generated were written for Lianki and checked for natural use

entries.term: 駅はどこですか？
entries.reading: えきはどこですか
entries.back: Where's the station?
entries.note: Start with すみません to stop a passer-by.

entries.term: 最寄りの駅はどこですか？
entries.reading: もよりのえきはどこですか
entries.back: Where's the nearest station?
entries.note: 最寄り is the everyday word for 'nearest' with stations and stops.

entries.term: そこって遠いですか？
entries.reading: そこってとおいですか
entries.back: Is it far?
entries.note: Follow-up after someone points you somewhere.

entries.term: 歩いてどれくらいかかりますか？
entries.reading: あるいてどれくらいかかりますか
entries.back: How long is it on foot?
entries.note: Deciding whether to walk or take a train or taxi.

entries.term: 地図で教えてもらえますか？
entries.reading: ちずでおしえてもらえますか
entries.back: Could you show me on the map?
entries.note: Hold out your phone map when asking directions.

entries.term: 次の角を右に曲がってください。
entries.reading: つぎのかどをみぎにまがってください
entries.back: Turn right at the next corner.
entries.note: Typical direction you'll hear; 左 is left.

entries.term: この道を行けば駅に着くよ。
entries.reading: このみちをいけばえきにつくよ
entries.back: This road takes you to the station.
entries.note: A friendly local giving simple directions.

entries.term: 道に迷ってしまいました。
entries.reading: みちにまよってしまいました
entries.back: I'm lost.
entries.note: Polite way to ask a stranger or police box for help.

entries.term: 切符はどこで買えますか？
entries.reading: きっぷはどこでかえますか
entries.back: Where can I buy a ticket?
entries.note: At a station or bus terminal; most locals tap an IC card instead.

entries.term: この電車、新宿に止まりますか？
entries.reading: このでんしゃしんじゅくにとまりますか
entries.back: Does this train stop at Shinjuku?
entries.note: Ask on the platform; express trains skip many stations.

entries.term: 乗り換えは必要ですか？
entries.reading: のりかえはひつようですか
entries.back: Do I need to change trains?
entries.note: To station staff or someone on the platform.

entries.term: すみません、ここ何駅ですか？
entries.reading: すみませんここなにえきですか
entries.back: Excuse me, what station is this?
entries.note: Asking a fellow passenger when you missed the announcement.

entries.term: 次の駅で降ります。
entries.reading: つぎのえきでおります
entries.back: I'm getting off at the next stop.
entries.note: Telling someone you're with, or the person blocking the door.

entries.term: すみません、降ります！
entries.reading: すみませんおります
entries.back: Excuse me, getting off!
entries.note: Said while squeezing out of a packed train or bus.

entries.term: ドアが閉まります。ご注意ください。
entries.reading: ドアがしまりますごちゅういください
entries.back: The doors are closing. Please stand clear.
entries.note: Platform announcement — don't try to squeeze in.

entries.term: 終電は何時ですか？
entries.reading: しゅうでんはなんじですか
entries.back: What time is the last train?
entries.note: Trains stop around midnight; essential on a night out.

entries.term: 乗り過ごしちゃった。
entries.reading: のりすごしちゃった
entries.back: I missed my stop.
entries.note: Usually after dozing off on the train.

entries.term: 電車が遅れてるみたい。
entries.reading: でんしゃがおくれてるみたい
entries.back: Looks like the train's delayed.
entries.note: Telling a friend, often in a message.

entries.term: このバス、駅に行きますか？
entries.reading: このバスえきにいきますか
entries.back: Does this bus go to the station?
entries.note: Ask the driver as you get on.

entries.term: バス乗り場はどこですか？
entries.reading: バスのりばはどこですか
entries.back: Where do I catch the bus?
entries.note: At a big station with many bus stops.

entries.term: バス行っちゃった。
entries.reading: バスいっちゃった
entries.back: The bus just left.
entries.note: Watching it pull away, with a friend.

entries.term: なんでバス来ないんだろう？
entries.reading: なんでバスこないんだろう
entries.back: Why isn't the bus coming?
entries.note: Grumbling at the stop.

entries.term: 駅までお願いできますか？
entries.reading: えきまでおねがいできますか
entries.back: To the station, please.
entries.note: Telling the taxi driver where to go; swap in an address or place.

entries.term: ここで止めてください。
entries.reading: ここでとめてください
entries.back: You can stop here, please.
entries.note: To a taxi driver near your destination.

entries.term: タクシーで行こうよ。
entries.reading: タクシーでいこうよ
entries.back: Let's take a taxi.
entries.note: Suggesting it to friends, e.g. after the last train.

entries.term: 渋滞にひっかかったんだ。
entries.reading: じゅうたいにひっかかったんだ
entries.back: I got stuck in traffic.
entries.note: Explaining why you're late.

entries.term: どこで待ち合わせする？
entries.reading: どこでまちあわせする
entries.back: Where should we meet?
entries.note: Planning with a friend; often a station exit or landmark.

entries.term: 駅まで一緒に行かない？
entries.reading: えきまでいっしょにいかない
entries.back: Want to walk to the station together?
entries.note: Leaving a party or class with a friend.

entries.term: 着くの何時ごろになりそう？
entries.reading: つくのなんじごろになりそう
entries.back: Around what time will you get here?
entries.note: Asking a friend who's on the way.

entries.term: 駅着いたら電話するね。
entries.reading: えきついたらでんわするね
entries.back: I'll call when I get to the station.
entries.note: Arranging a pick-up or meet-up.

entries.term: もうすぐ着くよ。
entries.reading: もうすぐつくよ
entries.back: Almost there!
entries.note: Messaging a friend who's waiting.

entries.term: 遅れてごめん。
entries.reading: おくれてごめん
entries.back: Sorry I'm late.
entries.note: To a friend when you finally arrive.
